description: Alerts pushed from a threat intelligence feed over the Logs Ingestion API.

columns.name: AlertCreated
columns.description: When the feed raised the alert. Kept separate from TimeGenerated so feed latency stays measurable.

columns.name: AlertQuery
columns.description: Query or rule the feed matched on.

columns.name: AlertSource
columns.description: Which feed or collection the alert came from.

columns.name: HighlightText
columns.description: Matched excerpt, flattened for full-text search.

columns.name: Tags
columns.description: Feed tags. Dynamic rather than a delimited string, so tags stay individually queryable.

columns.name: RawData
columns.description: Full original payload, retained for reprocessing.
